title: Desk surface protocol v0: drag and drop
description: ADR 0119's drag broker, run by the compositor: a surface starts a drag of desk data while a press on it is held; the compositor draws it and offers its types to the surface under the pointer, which answers with an effect; only the surface it lands on receives the items. A drop hands over paths and data, never access. See input.md.

SurfaceDropEffect.description: What a drop does with the data: the source keeps it (copy), gives it up (move), or the target refers to it (link).

SurfaceDropAnswer.description: An effect, or none: the target refuses, or the drag was cancelled.

SurfaceDropEffects.description: The effects a source allows, each at most once.

SurfaceDragType.description: A type of desk data: desk/paths, desk/text, desk/uri, desk/json:<kind> (db/rows), text/plain. In a list of accepted types, desk/json alone takes every kind.

SurfacePathKind.description: What a dragged path names, when the source knows.

SurfaceDragPath.description: An absolute bridge path (/…, ~/…, C:/…) with no .. segment.

SurfaceDragText.description: desk/text: text the source means as text.

SurfaceDragUri.description: desk/uri: a URI, never javascript: or vbscript:, and its title.

SurfaceDragJson.description: desk/json: typed JSON whose kind (lowercase segments: db/rows, docker/container) names its shape; offered as desk/json:<kind>.

SurfaceDragPlainText.description: text/plain: the fallback every drag offers; the compositor makes it from the other items when the source gives none.

SurfaceDragItem.description: One representation of what is dragged. A drag offers each type at most once, and all its items together are 4 MiB at most.

SurfaceDragImage.description: What the compositor draws under the pointer; without it the compositor names the items itself (a file's name, 3 items). src is a data:image/(png|jpeg|gif|webp);base64 URL of 512 KiB at most.

SurfaceDragAccept.description: The types this surface's drop targets take, all together; an empty list takes none. A surface that takes none of a drag's types hears nothing of it.

SurfaceDragStart.description: Start a drag from this surface. The compositor takes it only while a press on this surface is held, so a surface cannot drag on its own; it then owns the pointer until the release, and the surface hears drag.ended.

SurfaceDragEnter.description: A drag came over the surface. types is the offered types it accepts, never empty; from is the plugin the drag started in, os for a drag from the operating system, desk for the desk's own. The surface answers drag.status.

SurfaceDragOver.description: The drag moved over the surface, or its modifier keys changed. The surface answers drag.status.

SurfaceDragLeave.description: The drag left the surface, or was cancelled over it.

SurfaceDragStatus.description: The surface's answer to the last drag.enter or drag.over: the effect a drop there would perform, or none. By default Alt copies, Mod moves and both link, as Finder does.

SurfaceDragDrop.description: The drag landed on the surface with the effect it last answered, never none: here are the items of the types it accepts. The surface answers drag.done.

SurfaceDragDone.description: The effect the target performed with a drop: the one agreed, or none when it failed or changed its mind.

SurfaceDragEnded.description: To the source: how its drag ended, the effect performed (none: refused or cancelled) and the plugin the items went to.
